context: Asuka lectures on argument and stance.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: lecture; stance connectives (に対する/に関して/に関する/つつ/のみ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 意見に対する反論も、尊重しましょう。
lines.en: Let's respect counterarguments to an opinion too.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: その問題に関して、資料はありますか?
lines.en: Are there materials regarding that issue?
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious attentive throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 歴史に関する資料が、役立ちます。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 事実のみで、説得できるんですか?
lines.en: Can you persuade with facts alone?
lines.style: thoughtful young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 事実のみでなく、感情も大切です。
lines.en: Not facts alone — emotion matters too.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 相手に対する敬意も、必要ですね。
lines.en: Respect toward the other party is needed too.
lines.style: understanding young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 相手を尊重しつつ、主張を述べます。
lines.en: We state our claim while respecting the other.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: この件に関して、よく分かりました。
lines.en: I understand well regarding this matter.
lines.style: grateful young student voice, soft warm appreciative throughout
